desc: Since 1919 O.F. Mossberg & Sons has delivered the greatest value and the ultimate shooting experience for our customers. This turkey season, Mossberg aims to bring you the best shotguns to get the most out of your hunt. Our extensive lineup offers something for everyone, ranging from the experienced turkey hunter to a first-timer. Mossy Oak Obsession (Turkey) and Mossy Oak Shadow Grass Blades (Waterfowl) Features: Vent rib, X-Faxtor Choke, Adjustable fiber Optic sights, Synthetic stock.
